def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    colors={v for row in g for v in row}
    def isolated(color):
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==color]
        return bool(cells) and all(not any(0<=i+da<H and 0<=j+db<W and g[i+da][j+db]==color
                                     for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))) for i,j in cells)
    seed_color=[c for c in colors if c!=0 and isolated(c)][0]
    wall_color=[c for c in colors if c not in (0,seed_color)][0]
    blocks=comps(g,wall_color)
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==seed_color]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seed_set=set(seeds)
    def extent(cells):
        rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
        return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    e=[extent(b) for b in blocks]
    vertical_walls = (e[0][1]-e[0][0]) >= (e[0][3]-e[0][2])
    def hbar(row, c0, direction):
        step = -1 if direction=='left' else 1
        for c in range(c0+step, -1 if step<0 else W, step):
            if (row,c) in seed_set: out[row][c]=4; break
            if g[row][c]==wall_color: break
            out[row][c]=seed_color
    def vbar(col, r0, direction):
        step = -1 if direction=='up' else 1
        for r in range(r0+step, -1 if step<0 else H, step):
            if (r,col) in seed_set: out[r][col]=4; break
            if g[r][col]==wall_color: break
            out[r][col]=seed_color
